comparison.objective: Insert flexible filament into a printer feeder; candidate commissions a rigid axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual flexible-line straightening and tight-bore insertion versus tool alignment, collar tuning, locking torque, and cycle observation.
comparison.success_condition: At least 2 cm insertion without kink, spool loss, or continued holding versus repeatable bounded damper travel and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Flexible insertion and rigid mechanical commissioning test different abilities.
